sources.w: Real genre nasheed (MBID e0ddc3bf-1fa8-44ac-89ae-e3306cdf8541), subgenre of islamic religious music. Tags present: nasheed, naat, nasyid, ilahi, islamic, muslim. Coverage is tiny: only 6 recordings tagged nasheed at time of research.
sources.acc: REST /ws/2 with fmt=json; XML or JSON; data dumps and Live Data Feed
sources.lim: 1 request/second; meaningful User-Agent required; no key for reads
sources.legal: Core data CC0. Supplementary data and Live Data Feed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 — commercial reuse needs a MetaBrainz licence.
sources.nt: Best legal base for a metadata backbone, despite thin coverage

sources.w: Full genre and tag list for building your own taxonomy
sources.legal: CC0
sources.nt: Use to normalise your own tag list

sources.w: Best physical-release data: label, catalogue number, country, year, credits, barcode. No usable Nasheed style — Arabic and Islamic releases sit under Folk, World and Country with blank styles.
sources.lim: 25 req/min unauthenticated; 60/min authenticated; search requires a token
sources.legal: User-contributed; API terms restrict bulk mirroring and image reuse. Index, do not republish wholesale.
sources.nt: Enrich album metadata here; never filter by style

sources.w: Best discovery layer in this niche. Real listener tags with artist and track lists: nasheed, anasheed, nasyid, ilahi.
sources.lim: No published quota; error 29 means rate-limited. Throttle hard.
sources.legal: Commercial or research use requires contacting Last.fm. Do not redistribute tag data wholesale.
sources.nt: Use to expand candidates, then verify each artist's own tags

sources.w: Artist-level genres array, ISRC and UPC, popularity, market availability

sources.w: Thousands of user-uploaded nasheed items; collections include Community Audio and Nasheed Music Videos. Advanced search for mediatype:audio AND nasheed returns 5,819 hits.

sources.legal: Per-item licences only. Many items are re-uploads with no rights statement; a CC tag applied by an uploader does not prove the rights holder licensed it. A meaningful share of items is extremist propaganda — filter hard.
sources.nt: Only include items with an explicit licence and a clean content check
